card.name: Linking words before environmental stress terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words (to, of, are, tolerate) right before an expected word like stress, stressful or harsh conditions. The setting is biology or ecology text on organisms coping with cold, low oxygen, salt, drought or altitude.

modes.label: to after adapt/tolerant/sensitivity
modes.description: The word 'to' after a word of adaptation, tolerance or sensitivity, where an environmental stressor comes next.

modes.label: cause or period linking words
modes.description: Words like 'due to' or 'period of' that lead into adverse conditions.
modes.example: to tide the plant over a period<< of>> adverse conditions, such as summer droughts

modes.label: Other words before a stressor
modes.description: Words such as 'tolerate' or 'cold' placed just before the stressor is named.
modes.example: They prefer warm temperatures around 84 degrees Fahrenheit and do not<< tolerate>> cold temperatures.

card.writes: It raises the chance that the next word is stress or stressful, as in environmental stress.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a stress-like term, in text about how plants and animals cope with harsh conditions.
